issue_title: [Bug] next_id returns incorrect ID when todos have non-contiguous IDs after deletion
approach: Replace max()+1 algorithm with smallest unused positive integer finder

source_files.description: Changed next_id to find smallest unused ID instead of max+1

test_files.description: Added 4 regression tests for next_id with non-contiguous IDs

risks: For users expecting monotonically increasing IDs, this changes behavior to fill gaps
